description: This source file contains an implementation of the ManufacturerDao interface, providing database access methods for Manufacturer entities, such as listing manufacturers by store, retrieving by ID, counting products attached to a manufacturer, and listing by product categories.

classes.name: ManufacturerDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ManufacturerDao interface providing JPA-based data access methods for Manufacturer entities.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of distinct products attached to the specified manufacturer.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a Manufacturer entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all manufacturers associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers linked to products belonging to specified categories within a store, filtered by language.
